user_saw: An automatic session-reset hook could fail with “Async work scope is closed” and skip its delayed work after the triggering request ended.
summary: The fix gives automatic session-reset hooks their own async work scope while preserving Gateway drain accounting.
reasoning: The hook shipped in #61675 with an independent Gateway work reservation, before #136146 introduced the async work scope and its closed-scope rejection. The fix's test shows how a delayed callback inherits a closed requester scope, but the available history did not establish which commit first put the affected production reset path under a scope that closed before the callback resumed.
